spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fast asleep, sleeping much.
E.
शी to sleep, intens. v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sleeping much or soundly.
E.
शी to sleep, intens. v., क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Enlarging, expanding.
E.
श्वि to increase, intens. v., शानच् aff.

n. (-षं)
Remainder, leavings, rest, balance; what is left, omitted or rejected.
m. (-षः)
1 The king of the serpent race, as a large thousand-headed snake, at once the couch and canopy of VIṢṆU, and the upholder of the world, which rests on one of his heads.
2 A name of

Killing, destroying, finishing.
f. (-षा)
Flowers and other things that have been offered to an idol, and are then distributed amongst the worshippers and attendants.
E.
शिष to specify, aff. घञ्.

n. (-लं)
The last term, the time of death.
E.
शेष, and काल time.

m. (-गः)
The last or remaining part.
E.
शेष, and भाग portion.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Who eats the leavings of others.
E.
शेष, and भुज् who eats.

n. (-नं)
1 Eating the rest of the food after feeding the family, guests, &c.
2 Eating the leavings of a meal.
E.
शेष, and भोजन food.

n. (-णं)
Taking care that an undertaking is brought to a conclusion.
E.
शेष, and रक्षण preserving.

f. (-त्रिः)
The last watch of the night.
E.
शेष the remainder, and रात्रि night.

n. (-न्नं)
Leavings of a meal, &c.
E.
शेष, and अन्न food.

f. (-स्था)
The last state or condition of life.
E.
शेष, and अवस्था state.
